description: Walks the points in time at which a resource frees up, newest first.

Reservation scheduling has to answer "when could this job start". Rather than sampling time, the iterator visits only the instants at which some booking ends, because the answer can only change there.

attributes.name: total
description: The resource's full capacity, the value utilization is compared against.

attributes.name: resource_instance
description: Reference to the resource being walked (`RUE_Type`), whose utilization diagram holds the bookings.

attributes.name: queue_end_next
description: Cursor into that utilization diagram: the next booking end this iterator will report.
